current_candidate.summary: Spaces v32 removes the rejected random-cylinder scene from the visible selector, preserves the liked arch nave and calzada unchanged, enriches tunnel walls/roof with a second finer real-stone texture layer while keeping the v31 depth falloff and world-space motion, and turns the megatower bridge into an almost-line: RITUAL_ROAD_HALF .18 (full width .36), lateral limit .08, one hairline center guide, no stripe field and no bright edge rims. Tower gap remains 1.90 and radius remains 3.20.

open_feedback: Review Map 1 only for preservation: user explicitly likes it and v32 leaves renderMap1 unchanged from v31.
Review visible scene 2 calzada only for preservation: renderMap3 unchanged from v31.
Review tunnel texture richness: second finer warm real-stone layer should add wall/roof detail without breaking world anchoring or depth falloff.
Review megatower path: full width .36 should read nearly as a suspended line rather than a floor.
Cylinder scene is intentionally removed from the visible selector; internal dormant renderer remains only to avoid destabilizing unrelated code.
